skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target in a 3-hit combo.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 500% Max HP [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Each time the Ultimate is used, increases its DMG by an additional 15%, up to 2 stacks. After the first Ultimate cast, whenever an enemy leaves the [Extreme Tenacity] state, Bomb & Bang unleash [Roaring Aura Sky Ripping Fist], performing a 5-hit combo that deals 600% Max HP [Specialized Direct DMG]. Can trigger up to 1 time per turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 700% Max HP [Specialized Direct DMG] to all enemies (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Each time the Ultimate is used, increases its DMG by an additional 20%, up to 2 stacks. After the first Ultimate cast, whenever an enemy leaves the [Extreme Tenacity] state, Bomb & Bang unleash [Roaring Aura Sky Ripping Fist], performing a 5-hit combo that deals 800% Max HP [Specialized Direct DMG]. Can trigger up to 3 times per turn.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. At battle start, permanently removes enemies’ [Energy Conversion], makes all allies immune to [Energy Pressure], and prevents all enemies from restoring [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. At battle start, permanently removes enemies’ [Energy Conversion], makes all allies immune to [Energy Pressure], and prevents all enemies from restoring [Specialized HP].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. At battle start, permanently removes enemies’ [Energy Conversion], makes all allies immune to [Energy Pressure], and prevents all enemies from restoring [Specialized HP].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own base Max HP by 60%. At battle start, gains [Defiance Boost] and [Defiance Guard]. When allies’ HP or [Specialized HP] take DMG, that instance of DMG is reduced by 99%, and 99% of the original DMG is converted into [Energy Shield]. The total [Energy Shield] gained this way is capped at 28 times Bomb & Bang’s base Max HP. This effect cannot coexist with [Revive] (only one can be active at a time). Once the [Energy Shield] cap is reached, the DMG reduction effect no longer applies. [Defiance Boost]: Increases DMG dealt by 30%. If Bomb & Bang’s base Max HP is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG dealt is increased to 1.5×. [Defiance Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 30%. If Bomb & Bang’s base Max HP is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction is increased to 1.5×.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own base Max HP by 80%. At battle start, gains [Defiance Boost] and [Defiance Guard]. When allies’ HP or [Specialized HP] take DMG, that instance of DMG is reduced by 99%, and 99% of the original DMG is converted into [Energy Shield]. The total [Energy Shield] gained this way is capped at 35 times Bomb & Bang’s base Max HP. This effect cannot coexist with [Revive] (only one can be active at a time). Once the [Energy Shield] cap is reached, the DMG reduction effect no longer applies. Converts the [Energy Shield] gained by allies into 10% of [Specialized HP] with an additional 50% increase in conversion rate, and nullifies the enemy’s [Specialized HP DMG Reduction] effect. [Defiance Boost]: Increases DMG dealt by 50%. If Bomb & Bang’s base Max HP is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG dealt is increased to 1.7×. [Defiance Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 50%. If Bomb & Bang’s base Max HP is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction is increased to 1.7×.

The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
